newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt pound/dlr rates down due to outflows.
newsitem.headline: Egypt pound/dlr rates down due to outflows.

text.p: The Egyptian pound fell slightly against the dollar in the private sector market on Thursday due to cash outflows, bankers said.
"The dollar is in demand due to some foreign outflows," a banker told Reuters.
Another said the outflow was a result of lack of interest by foreign investors in buying t-bills and the weak stock market.
Private-sector Egyptian banks said the dollar ranged from 3.3940 and 3.3950 pounds bid and 3.3960 and 3.3980 pounds offered in the interbank market.
A survey of four actively trading banks gave average rates of 3.3943 pounds bid and 3.3973 pounds offered. The averages compared with 3.3939 pounds bid and 3.3956 pounds offered on Wednesday.
The Central Bank calculated the average exchange rate at midday as 3.393657 buy and 3.399468 sell.
